newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria spot week depo rates fall amid low demand.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria spot week depo rates fall amid low demand.

text.p: Demand for interbank deposits was low on Bulgaria's money market on Tuesday amid high lev liquidity in the banking system, and spot week rates fell from Monday, dealers said.
Spot week rates eased to around 2.5-3.0 percent annually from Monday's 3.0-3.5 percent, as overnight depo rates held unchanged at 1.50-1.75 percent annually.
The average annual interbank deposit rate was 2.38 percent on Monday, down from 2.82 percent on Friday, a central bank official said.
The central bank simple annual main interest rate has been set at 5.42 percent from Monday, down from 6.12 percent last week.
